text:
ana_ae: Heads-up: Beacon Labs trial suddenly started returning 5xxs during their pre-demo ramp. Load generator showed ~95-130 rps bursts. Demo in ~15m. Need a short checklist we can run now.

raj_support: Any sample error or request_id? Region / model?

ana_ae: Region eu-west-1, model=redwood-open-3b-q4. Example from their harness:
```
POST /v1/chat.generate
...
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
x-rw-queue-depth: 52
{"error":"upstream timeout","request_id":"req_beacon_77"}
```
Also seeing 502s intermittently.

eli_infra: Sounds like queue saturation + autoscaler heat. Two immediate options: 1) short-term route-level failover to smaller model, 2) enable per-customer burstpool if policy allows. Both are quick.

raj_support: Can we do API-layer failover only for this API key?

eli_infra: Yes. Command I can run now: 
```
redwoodctl api-keys update --id key-beacon --set failover_model=redwood-open-1b-q4 --set failover_threshold_latency=600ms
```
I can also flip burstpool attach: 
```
redwoodctl customers update --id beacon --set allow_burst=true
```
Either will lower immediate error rate; failover has near-zero infra cost.

ana_ae: AE asked about cost impact if we permanently bump min_replicas for trials. Need a back-of-envelope figure to tell them in demo.

nina_se: Quick estimate: adding min_replicas=1 for the 3B pool in eu-west ~+$650/day; min_replicas=2 ~+$1300/day. If they use fallback to 1B during spikes, cost delta is minimal for short demos. I'll follow up with precise quote.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: route update for customer beacon -> allow_burst=true (deploy id d-2026-510).

raj_support: While that rolls, please grab the proxy traces around req_beacon_77 and queue/memory metrics for the last 20m. `curl -H "x-request-id: req_beacon_77" https://logs.internal/bundle` and `redwoodctl metrics query --name queue_depth --since 20m --filter customer=beacon`

ana_ae: Logs uploaded to the incident ticket INC-2026-0510-09. After flipping allow_burst, errors dropped to <5/min and demo proceeded.

eli_infra: Follow-ups:
- run a quick audit of trial routing policies to ensure burstpool auto-attach conditions match what our metrics threshold actually emits (queue_depth>40 and pending_coldstarts>0).
- consider a lightweight prewarm signal when AE schedules a demo so we can prebind 1 replica.
- add a short note to the AE trial onboarding: "For sustained spikes >80rps, enable fallback or request prewarm 1 replica."

nina_se: I'll append pricing note to the trial one-pager and share with AE.

ana_ae: Great work — demo completed successfully. Keeping the ticket open for the infra follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
